scope: WT1.2 gate probes at 27ec4c0 on the ABI 78 kernel SDKs of ObfuscationKernel 1249613: the Linux interval timer probe (tests/musl/linux_timers.c), the clock drift probe (tests/musl/clock_drift.c, 13 samples over 120 s bracketed by the host's clocks, then 3 s of syscall-free user code) with the kernel's OK_TIMER_LATENCY, QMP send-key input on the seven profiles with an input device, and the native UDP socket test on x86_64.
claims: the interval timer probe passes on all ten profiles
the monotonic clock drift and its strict bound lie within 100 ppm of the host's on all ten profiles
timer interrupt latency is reported for idle and user ticks on all ten profiles
injected keys are served after their interrupts and never polled on the seven input profiles
every network pass of the native UDP test is served after a NIC interrupt, none polled
